name: Goetia
description: (Tag:informant)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:magician)(Tag:summoner)(Character)Goetia is the King of Demons, a hivemind of 72 Demon Gods and supreme magic system. He nullifies all magic with Solomon's 9 rings, is immortal while any pillar lives with revival in his Temple of Time unless breached, holds nigh-omniscience seeing past, present, and future, and masters magic utterly, ripping souls with a gaze.
